in_marathi.name: Balaji
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balaji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Balaji is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bal' which means strength and 'Ji' meaning Lord. Balaji is a name of Lord Vishnu, particularly revered in the southern states of India. It is also known as 'Lord Venkateswara' and 'Balasubrahmanyam'. The name signifies the one who is the source of all strength and power.
